propositions: Empty file_impact is overloaded between undeclared edits (should trigger whole-HEAD invalidation) and genuinely-no-impact changes (should not invalidate), causing false conservative invalidations
A single non-closed child with empty file_impact poisons the entire container's drift scope to empty, collapsing all sibling path declarations to whole-HEAD invalidation

The fix requires introducing tri-state file_impact_scope (undeclared, paths, none) with mandatory no_file_impact_reason when scope is none, such that explicit none-declarations enter the material fingerprint and do not poison containers
An explicitly declared no-file-impact ticket's attestation must remain valid across unrelated commits, while undeclared tickets still invalidate on any commit

A container with mixed path-declaring and explicitly no-file-impact children should inherit only the union of path-declaring children, with no-file-impact children contributing nothing and poisoning nothing
